shot: S2 - Mei runs through the night market, medium shot
design: Four prompt designs, four takes each. Each design locks MORE of the six fields than the one before it.

A.prompt: A girl running through a market at night with a box, cinematic.

B.prompt: @mei_sheet_v1 MEI (yellow raincoat, red scarf) runs through a night market holding @red_box_v1.

C.prompt: B + @night_market_plate_v1, blue-hour teal shadows with warm lantern practicals, light rain, 35mm film grain.

D.prompt: C + medium shot, eye level, 35mm lens, subject centred on the vertical centre line, locked-off camera; keep coat and scarf colours exactly as the sheet; no extra foreground people.

measures.sd_coat_hue: Wardrobe drift: spread of the raincoat's median hue across the four takes (OpenCV hue units).
measures.sd_subject_x_px: Blocking drift: spread of the subject's horizontal position.
measures.cv_subject_area: Framing drift: coefficient of variation of the subject's area (a shot-size proxy).
measures.sd_bg_warmth: Look drift: spread of background warmth (mean red minus mean blue).

simulation_note: The takes are SIMULATED with a designed, deterministic spread per cell so the ordering is guaranteed. Real model output is noisier - rerun the measurement on your own takes.
